atomic_facts.fact: The LEGO Group's legal name is LEGO System A/S.
The LEGO Group is registered in Denmark.
The LEGO Group is a Danish toy manufacturing company.
The LEGO Group is headquartered in Billund, Denmark.
As of December 2024, the Danish Supreme Court had not issued a conviction for price fixing against the LEGO Group.
The case was expected to continue into 2025.
